title: The Camera That Still Turns On at 3:17

story_profile.central_question: Why does the sealed hotel's camera still turn on every night?

idea.title: The Camera That Still Turns On at 3:17
idea.premise: A security camera records the same figure behind a glass door in a hotel sealed for eleven years.
idea.audience_promise: Follow the contradiction until the final recurrence makes the recording impossible to dismiss.
idea.central_question: Why does the sealed hotel's camera still turn on every night?

truth.disclosure: This episode is an original fictional suspense story; stock footage is used as declared visual representation.

causal_chain.cause: The camera records a figure behind a door that has been sealed for eleven years.
escalation: The guard waits beside the door and the lights go out.
When the lights return, the figure has moved into the hallway.
The police find no footprints, broken lock or person inside.
causal_chain.consequence: The recording captures the figure pointing at the camera one minute after the recurring trigger.
causal_chain.why_it_mattered: The hotel is demolished and the evidence is deleted, but the same camera still activates every night.

promise_payoff.promise: The opening promises an explanation for the figure behind the sealed glass.
promise_payoff.payoff: The final recurrence shows that demolition and deletion did not end the impossible event.
